## A1. Field-name casing: change, (b) camelCase now

- decision: `change`. Every field, query key and envelope member of `/jellyscale/v1/` is camelCase (`reason`, `action`, `retryAfterSeconds`, `detail`, `scope`, `token`, `positionMs`, `offset`, `limit`, `sort`…). Done in JS-216, before JS-184 serves anything.
- serves: Goal 3, "Octave's features have the server they need"; D-20261127-retire-jellyfin-comparisons: "the contract's casing is chosen for Octave's apps alone".
- reason: this is the cheapest the rename will ever be. Everything served is preview. Octave has built nothing on it. JS-190 is todo, so no pinned build exists to break. Kotlin, Swift and TypeScript decode camelCase without configuration, so fewer decoding bugs reach a viewer as an empty screen. (a) keeps a Jellyfin habit that no longer has a reason. (c) makes the contract two things for good. Viewers and operators see no change.
- the operations already served: the leaving operations (`playback-info`, `user-configuration`, `track-preferences`) keep their body fields as served and are marked leaving at the cutover. The refusal envelope is camelCase wherever it is sent, so an app decodes one envelope. Jellyfin's own routes keep Jellyfin's shapes.
- design text, replacing JS-216.md §1 "Names stay as served": "**Names are camelCase.** Every field, query key and refusal member in v1 is camelCase, applied before JS-184 serves anything. The leaving operations keep their served body fields until the cutover. The envelope is `{reason, action}`, plus `retryAfterSeconds`, `detail` and `scope`, everywhere." Bring §2–4 and the examples to it. §5 becomes: "The from:jellyscale notice names every renamed field and supersedes octave#391's `Reason` and `Action`." docs/api.md's example becomes `hideOtherAudio`, not `hideotheraudio`.
- JS-208 criterion added: "Its baseline is the camelCase contract of JS-216."
- entry: "The v1 contract is camelCase throughout, applied in JS-216 before JS-184 serves anything. The leaving operations keep their served bodies until the cutover. The envelope is camelCase wherever it is sent. Octave is told by a from:jellyscale notice that supersedes octave#391."
tradeoff: (a) keeps a Jellyfin habit that no longer has a reason. (c) makes the contract two things for good. Viewers and operators see no change.
